  SECTION_SUMMARYINFO = 9,              /* AcDb:SummaryInfo */
  SECTION_PREVIEW = 10,                 /* AcDb:Preview */
  SECTION_APPINFO = 11,                 /* AcDb:AppInfo */
  SECTION_APPINFOHISTORY = 12,          /* AcDb:AppInfoHistory */
  SECTION_FILEDEPLIST = 13,             /* AcDb:FileDepList */

} Dwg_Section_Type;
